title: An explore with view_name resolves its base view and its refinements
rule: view_name binds an explore to a view of a different name, and +explore refinements apply to that explore.

citations.quote: view_name determines the view that will define the fields of an Explore.
With LookML refinements, you can adapt an existing view or Explore without editing the LookML file that contains it.
This refinement can go in any LookML file in the project, such as a model file, view file, or in its own dedicated LookML file.
Within a single file, refinements are applied line by line going downwards.
